list.text: Cetanāhaṁ, bhikkhave, kammaṁ vadāmi. Cetayitvā kammaṁ karoti—kāyena vācāya manasā.
list.author: Anguttara Nikaya 6.63

list.text: The Definition of Kamma : Monks, it is intention that I call kamma. Having intended, one performs kamma through body, speech, and mind.
list.author: The Buddha (AN 6.63)

list.text: The Essence of Karma : Monks, it is intention that I call kamma. Having intended, one performs kamma through body, speech, and mind.
list.author: The Buddha (AN 6.63)
